latest.title: Governing the Agent Control Plane on AWS: RAR, RSI, and DCS — The Three SLIs Amazon Bedrock Orchestration Needs
latest.description: Amazon Bedrock Agents now supports multi-agent collaboration, enabling orchestrator agents to decompose tasks and route subtasks across specialist agents. This architecture introduces a new reliability layer: the agent control plane the orchestration logic that manages task decomposition, agent routing, retry behavior, and priority queuing across your entire Bedrock agent fleet.

latest.title: Beyond the Dashboard: The Mental and Technical Grind of Mastering AWS Databases
latest.description:
I almost didn't finish this project.

Not because the tasks were too hard. Not because I didn't understand the concepts. But because at some point during the night, the light went out.

No power. Laptop battery draining. AWS CLI still open. Project half done.

That is the reality of building in Nigeria. You don't just fight the technology — you fight the environment around you too.

But I found somewhere to charge. Sat back down. Opened the terminal again. And kept going.

latest.title: What Students Need to Know About Building with AWS: How AWS Free Tier Helped Me Learn by Doing
latest.description: AWS Free Tier opened the door for me to learn cloud by doing—risk‑free, hands‑on, and without financial barriers. trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: Global Impact AI Navigator
trending.description: Global Impact AI Navigator (GIAN) is a multi-agent AI platform built on Amazon Bedrock that transforms a raw idea into a complete strategic package in under 60 seconds — SWOT diagnostic, live-grounded funding discovery, personalized roadmap, and a context-aware advisor. Designed for innovators in emerging markets, it democratizes access to the strategic guidance that usually requires expensive consultants or elite networks.
